firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi Kaggle / ARC Prize team,

I’ve opened a technical-review request with Kaggle Support and contacted the ARC Prize team, but I’m posting a concise record here as well.

Our exact ARC-AGI-3 notebook Version 1 was COMPLETE before the Sep 30, 23:59 UTC Milestone 2 deadline:

Kernel:
yuriimuktarov/arc3-r15-v2-provenance-replay-20260930

Version:
1

Script Version ID:
354136749

The completed Public25 benchmark had:

25 runs
mean = 14.217361417701987
wins = 2

Before the deadline, we attempted “Submit to Competition”.

Kaggle returned:

“Could not find provided output file benchmark.json”

We preserved a screenshot of that pre-deadline error.

Read-only inspection confirms the exact Version 1 contains:

benchmark.json
score.json
submission.parquet

No scientific payload was modified.

The submission was later accepted as:

Submission Ref: 56744766
Current status: PENDING

We understand that the official submission itself was created after the deadline and are not claiming automatic Milestone eligibility.

We are asking whether Kaggle / the competition hosts can review the server-side records for the pre-deadline submission error and determine whether any discretionary technical accommodation is available.

Kaggle Support has been asked to verify:

1. Version 1 completion timestamp;
2. the pre-deadline output-binding error;
3. the output file Kaggle attempted to bind;
4. the binding of submission 56744766 to Version 1;
5. notebook visibility/license state at the milestone deadline.

We have preserved the screenshots and SHA-256 evidence package.

Thank you.
